sources.scope: LIST menus, capacity, edit/storage/recall/result paging, sample variance, multiplication, scalar-add rejection, inner/outer product, empty slot and matrix conversion; NORMAL function fraction, CPLX pi and guide transition matrix.

notes: Independent 218-key live session; 63 significant checkpoints. Intermediate application frames are characterization, not independent simulator evidence. Unprobed LIST operations and type restrictions remain pending.
Step 42: Size 16 accepted; resizing clears buffer cells; stored L1 remains [3,1,2].
Step 66: 2nd F ENT (ANS) is unavailable in LIST and consumes the modifier.
Step 78:  Upper line is only the visible clipped prefix.
Step 96: list→mat switches to MAT mode.
Step 97: Conversion does not replace matrix edit buffer.
Step 102: CHK matA selects the converted stored matrix; DOWN opens its dimensions.
Step 109: 2nd F ENT is unavailable in MAT as well as LIST.
Step 115: MODE transition clears LIST stores; evaluating empty L1 reports Error 10.
Step 135: L1+1 is unsupported (scalar addition does not broadcast).
Step 142: L1×2 returns a three-element list.
Step 166: o_prod(L1,L2) accepts two three-element stored vectors.

Step 177: Native fraction separator retained for a function denominator. The application now projects the same 2┌tan17= upper line and decimal 6.541705237 lower line; raw source/state serialization remains separate from the rendered LCD.
Step 181: Pi is available in CPLX. applicationUpper records HTML entity serialization of the same glyph. Application rendering serialization: π=.
Step 188: Guide transition-matrix row-major data entry starts after setting 2×2 dimensions.
